description: This file defines a serializer class CompareInfoCodec for serializing and deserializing the CompareInfo type within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing CompareInfo objects, handling references, and managing serialization headers.

classes.name: CompareInfoCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing CompareInfo objects within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a CompareInfo object from the serialization stream, handling references and reading the 'name' property.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a CompareInfo object to the serialization stream, writing reference information and the 'Name' property.
